sources.snippet: Overview deberta-v3-small is a compact encoder model developed by microsoft that performs masked language modeling and serves as a foundation for downstream natural language understanding tasks. The model uses disentangled attention and gradient-disentangled embedding sharing trained with ELECTRA-style pre-training on 160GB of text data.
